migrate-email.name: Migrate transactional email from Resend to PostHog. Use when asked to migrate from Resend, replace Resend with PostHog, switch email providers, or re-import the Resend suppression list into PostHog after a migration. It finds every Resend send in the code, sets up the sender and DNS next to the records the app sends with now, imports the suppression list, moves each send PostHog can take to PostHog's SDK for its language (Node.js, Python, Go, Ruby, PHP, .NET, Rust, or Elixir), and writes a migration report that lists the sends that stay.
